Definition: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to conceal, hide, be hidden, be concealed, be secret; 1a) (Qal) secret (participle); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be concealed; 1b2) concealed, dissembler (participle); 1c) (Hiphil) to conceal, hide; 1d) (Hithpael) to hide oneself
